definitions.gloss: religious rite; ritual worship of gods or ancestors
definitions.explanation: The performing of rites to honor gods or ancestors, especially as a formal or traditional duty. A written word, used of Shinto, the imperial court and ancestor worship.

examples.japanese: {祭祀|さいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祭祀|さいし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Ancient rites are still carried on at this shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宮中|きゅうちゅう}→宮中：12653_kyuuchuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{祭祀|さいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}う→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧。
examples.english: The Emperor performs rites at the palace many times a year.

notes:
Formal and written; everyday speech says ⟦お{祭|まつ}り→お祭り：01349_omatsuri⟧ or ⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祭祀|さいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ / ⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}う→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧: to perform a rite
- ⟦{宮中|きゅうちゅう}→宮中：12653_kyuuchuu⟧{祭祀|さいし}: the rites of the imperial court
- ⟦{祖先|そせん}→祖先：04047_sosen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祭祀|さいし}: ancestor rites
- {祭祀|さいし}⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧: ritual property (family altar, graves; a legal term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{祭|まつ}る→祭る：03932_matsuru⟧: to enshrine, to worship — the verb behind it
- ⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧: ceremony — any formal ceremony, religious or not
